remote_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote audit server.

port.description: Port number to connect to on the remote server.

queue_depth.description: Maximum number of events that can be queued.

network_retry_time.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed network operation.

max_tries_per_record.description: Maximum number of attempts to send a single record before giving up.

max_time_per_record.description: Maximum time in seconds to attempt sending a single record.

heartbeat_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before a heartbeat is sent (0 = disabled).
